reason: A macOS Electron desktop companion that monitors local DeepSeek Harness session states and surfaces approval, completion, activity, idle, and offline notifications through a floating whale, sounds, and status bubbles.

summaries.zh: 一款 macOS 桌面伴侣应用，通过本地 DSH 接口监测会话状态，并用悬浮鲸鱼、气泡和音效提示审批、运行、完成、空闲或离线状态。
summaries.en: A macOS desktop companion that monitors local DSH session status and signals approval, active, completed, idle, or offline states with a floating whale, bubbles, and sounds.

capabilities: Reads session status from a local DSH HTTP interface
Receives local DSH status and approval updates through WebSocket connections
Displays floating desktop status indicators and plays configurable alert sounds
Opens the DSH GUI in the system browser
Loads user-provided visual and audio customization files
